cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

mechanism: A delegates the cashbox and uncomfortable explanation while correcting B's proposed handling and evidence presentation.
confusable: Simply avoiding blame is D125 alone; S03 must shape the handover through corrections rather than a label.
comparison: Physical cash custody differs from another alternative's documentary receipt chase.
seedUse: Use the broken lock, treasurer and counting seed; make B offer unattended storage so A corrects a real risk.
